name: SCiEL: Third autocorrelation inequality
description: Construct discretized function values minimizing c3 as computed by the pinned evaluator using maximum absolute self-convolution. This is the upstream numerical contract.

limitations: Source-inspected SCiEL example; not a reproduced paper result.
The original evaluator and baseline are fetched at the immutable source commit; no upstream implementation is silently repaired.

The evaluator uses maximum absolute self-convolution and the stored benchmark 1.4556427953745406. Treat this as the pinned implementation contract; correspondence to differently stated paper formulas is not asserted.
The upstream evaluator provides no independently trusted validity boolean; a finite returned score remains unverified.
